about: The airport is in the Nikolaevsky District of Khabarovsk Krai, 2.5 km west of Nikolaevsk-on-Amur. Class G, one terminal for 50 passengers per hour. Operator: JSC Khabarovskie Avialinii.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Baggage storage at left luggage: 418.83 ₽ per item per day including VAT. If departure is delayed by more than 3 hours, checked baggage is stored at 0.88 ₽ per kg per hour. Prices per the price list from 5 June 2026.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Passenger service in the VIP room: 3,773.25 ₽ including VAT per service. Price per the price list from 5 June 2026.
